## 已核验的部分事实

以下研究项已有原文证据支撑，但整体证据不足以形成完整结论，仅供参考。

### Google 覆盖率门槛与缺陷逃逸实证 · 结论与限制条件

即使你所设计的测试用例已经达到 100% 的代码覆盖率，软件产品的质量也做不到万无一失。

- Evidence: `evidence:c8b31fb0e224e903bbb63811056b34b5d24ad1ca1b4e824c`
  - Exact quote: “即使你所设计的测试用例已经达到 100% 的代码覆盖率，软件产品的质量也做不到万无一失。”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/8bf75841-d21b-4e28-a853-0fcdecb95da6/b680d5d32ea0ab3596414931de27cb0c34d2598d2ffdb10b150320aae73836e2`
  - URL: https://www.cnblogs.com/Uni-Hoang/p/13232345.html

### 开源项目覆盖率门槛与缺陷逃逸实证 · 覆盖率门槛变化

Start with your current baseline and raise thresholds gradually, prioritizing the riskiest services first.

- Evidence: `evidence:6f5b7d1bcb8fb2898023bf0bdf586f09daeca4c9d6e7a872`
  - Exact quote: “Start with your current baseline and raise thresholds gradually, prioritizing the riskiest services first.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/be7f0959-025a-4f35-b3ab-32ea607c1e56/beaf6aa3e7560c791ab6ff7f2750331a34ab25f9131e476d00bdaeba2d5a95bc`
  - URL: https://www.harness.io/blog/code-coverage-measure-improve-and-scale-quality-in-ci
